headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.0-modder.19
summary: Heading home from a game no longer snaps: the last frame melts into the Back to Launcher screen, then the launcher fades in over it.

items.text: Smooth exits all the way back. Quitting Minecraft now cross-fades the last game frame into the Back to Launcher screen instead of cutting to it, and the launcher itself fades in once it is ready. The game window sticks around a little longer so the fade always has something to dissolve from, and the final handoff to the home screen no longer flashes.
